title: Why organic farming isn't a very good idea
summary: UK farmer argues synthetic nitrogen fertilizer is essential and that organic farming cannot feed today's population.

assertions.quote: you can't use pre-industrial farming techniques to feed a post-industrial population it just can't happen

verdicts.note: About half of food output depends on synthetic nitrogen; models suggest an organic world is feasible only with large cuts in waste and animal feed.

assertions.quote: warnings from scientists and agricultural advisers who said that that would cause a decrease in yields for various crops

verdicts.note: Sri Lanka's 2021 fertilizer ban was followed by steep rice and tea output falls and was reversed within months.

assertions.quote: the plants can't tell if the nitrogen is organic in humus or inorganic and synthetically produced

verdicts.note: Plants take up mineral nitrate and ammonium whatever the source, though organic inputs also change soil structure and release timing.

assertions.quote: some people say that organic produce is more nutritious but there's no reason for that
